tha-ap90:1.1: Saddasaññaka.] Pabbate Himavantamhi vasāmi paṇṇasanthare / Phussassa dhammaṃ bhaṇato sadde cittaṃ pasādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap90:2.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi puññakammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap90:3.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap90:4.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Saddasaññakothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
